# v0.9.23

## 中文

### 修复内容

- 修复首次进入技术方案“生成设置”时，未修改任何选项点击“保存生成设置”无效、导致“下一步”不可用的问题。
- 导出模板信息暂时读取失败时，未指定专用导出方式的项目仍可按基础格式保存生成设置。
- 返回前面步骤修改正文生成设置或全局事实后，清理失效的正文内容和暂停任务缓存，避免后续步骤被旧任务阻止。
- 正文任务仍在运行时，修改生成设置或全局事实会提示先暂停任务，避免新旧数据混用。

### 使用提示

- 修改“资料缺失时怎么写”后，请重新解析全局事实，再继续生成正文。
- 已经遇到暂停任务阻塞的项目，可返回“生成设置”重新保存，或保存全局事实，然后按当前配置重新生成正文。

## English

### Fixes

- Fixed the Save Generation Settings button doing nothing when no options were changed on first entry, which also kept Next disabled.
- When export template details cannot be loaded, projects without a selected custom export method can still save settings using the basic format.
- After editing generation settings or global facts in an earlier step, stale generated content and paused task state are cleared so the workflow can continue.
- While body generation is running, changing generation settings or global facts now prompts the user to pause the task first, preventing old and new data from being mixed.

### Usage notes

- After changing the missing-fact handling policy, regenerate global facts before continuing body generation.
- For projects already blocked by a paused task, save Generation Settings again or save Global Facts, then regenerate the body with the current configuration.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liwg1995/YuduBid/compare/v0.9.22...v0.9.23
